patches.name: Blue-noise dithering
patches.description: Adds fine grain that hides color steps; center and background can be toggled. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395.

options.title: Center of the view
options.description: Fine grain in the center of the view only. Uses the exact stock video shader or an OLED calibration; turn that patch's VD-like center option off when this is on.

options.title: Background
options.description: Fine grain over the whole background, including under the center overlay on top; the center's own grain choice is not touched.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the app so it can install next to the original. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Type a short name like Galaxy XR to add it to the app name as a package suffix, or a full package name like com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr.

patches.name: Codecs Support
patches.description: Lets the headset decode H.264 or AV1 streams; HEVC is untouched. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Needs: the matching driver codec setting.

options.title: Enable telemetry
options.description: Optional decoder measurements and codec-byte capture for SteamVR Colour Lab. Off installs no telemetry components.

patches.name: Controller grip haptics through Shizuku
patches.description: Sends controller vibration to the grip motor instead of the trigger. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. This needs Shizuku running with permission granted; without it vibration stays stock. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches.name: Controller pose time (experimental)
patches.description: Dates each controller pose by its sample time; the runtime labels poses 28.82 ms late. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Needs: not with Controller pose extrapolation or the HAL pose patch. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

options.title: Pose time compensation (ms)
options.description: How far before the runtime's label each controller pose is dated. Lower values shorten SteamVR's prediction: steadier, but the hands trail slightly. Higher values lengthen it: more responsive, but fast moves can overshoot and jerk. 0 ms sends the runtime's label unchanged; 29 ms is closest to the true sample time. Default: 5 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 30 ms. Change it with adb shell setprop debug.gxr.pose_time.lead_us <microseconds> without repatching.

patches.name: Controller tracking from the controller HAL through Shizuku
patches.description: Reads controller poses from the headset HAL, removing about 35 ms of lag. This needs Shizuku; without it tracking stays stock. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Angular velocity is local to the grip pose on 2.0.23/5002363 and in the base space on older builds. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches.name: Controller velocity frame
patches.description: Fixes thrown-object directions by rotating controller speeds into the frame SteamVR expects. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Angular velocity is local to the streamed pose on 2.0.23/5002363 and in the base space on older builds; measured on 2.0.23/5002363. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches.name: Device identity
patches.description: Reports the Galaxy XR headset identity to SteamVR (model xrvst2ue). Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.

patches.name: Force HMD initialization gates

patches.name: Force lobby permission-state gate

patches.name: Full-FOV foveal canvas (experimental)

patches.name: GXR spacewarp layer (experimental)
patches.description: Synthesizes a frame when the stream misses a display tick; any failure stands down to stock. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363. Experimental; headset validation pending.

patches.name: Galaxy XR SteamVR driver (galaxyxr)

options.title: Grip offset position (cm, x,y,z)
options.description: Offsets the controller position from your grip point, in cm: x right, y up, z backward (negative = forward). Default is calibrated on Galaxy XR. Stock Quest Touch value is -0.7,-3.416,-9.607.

options.title: Grip offset rotation (deg, x,y,z)
options.description: Rotates the controller model around your grip point, in degrees: x pitch, y yaw, z roll. Stock Quest Touch value is -20.6,0,0.

options.title: Microphone mode
options.description: Voice Recognition was the clearest and loudest tested on Galaxy XR. Voice Performance and Unprocessed are much quieter; Voice Communication sounds more processed.

patches.name: OLED color calibration
patches.description: Tunes OLED color with gamma and saturation presets. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Headset verification pending.

options.title: Calibration profile
options.description: Presets gamma and saturation. Applies to both layers, or only the background when a VD-like center option is on.

options.title: Gamma
options.description: Used with the Custom profile. Higher darkens dark tones. Range: 0.50 to 2.50.

options.title: Saturation
options.description: Used with the Custom profile. Higher makes colors more intense. Range: 0.00 to 3.00.

options.title: VD-like center mode
options.description: A sharper center look (VD-style), keeping Valve's color correction and 8-bit output. Skips the profile above in the center; the center gamma below still applies. Turn off when Blue-noise dithering's center option is on.

options.title: Center gamma adjustment
options.description: Extra gamma for the center only. 1.00 = unchanged; higher darkens dark tones. Try 1.02 first for a slightly lighter center. The background keeps the profile above; this is a manual tweak, not a verified seam fix.
